messages:
deploy-bot: ▶️ Starting staggered regional rollout for release v2.3.1 (artifact: rwd-inference-2026-03-21). Plan: US 5% -> EU 10% -> APAC 15% over next 3h. Fallback: v2.2.9 pinned. Change window 22:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-21
emma: Kicking off US 5% canary now. Can SRE confirm warm-pool and GPU headroom?
sre-oncall: US warm-pool healthy. Node headroom: 130/150 GPUs free, prewarmed slots: 40. No thermal alarms in last 30m. Cache warmup 62% (prefix hits).
kai: Runtime check: confirmed kernel selection for v2.3.1 on c5g-type will be fallback to quant-0.9 path. Expected p95 delta ~+8-12ms at this traffic.
neha: Noted. We've added a route rule that will fallback to v2.2.9 on error-rate>0.6% or if p95>300ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
deploy-bot: US canary at 5% stabilized after 10m. Metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.12%, p95=118ms, avg_latency=85ms. No anomalies.
maria: Product wants us to hold EU ramp until we see cache hit >=70% and KV prefetch completed. EU traffic pattern more cache-sensitive.
ryan: Triggered EU warmup job job-8423 (prewarm dedicated pool). Current ETA ~9m. Reserving extra 20 slots for EU as hedge. Created infra ticket: INF-3952.
sre-oncall: FYI APAC region has scheduled maintenance at 03:30 UTC on infra-provider side; recommend we avoid heavy ramp into APAC until after 04:00 UTC or reserve additional capacity.
emma: Decision: Proceed with US -> start EU canary at 10% once warmup hits 70%. Delay APAC ramp by 60 minutes to avoid maintenance window. Pin EU fallback to v2.2.9 and enable auto-rollback triggers: error_rate>=0.6% OR p95>=300ms sustained 3m.
deploy-bot: Noted. EU warmup at 58% now, will notify at 70%. EU route pinned: fallback=v2.2.9. APAC ramp window shifted +60m.
kai: Also enabling continuous-batching throttle for EU canary (max batch size 32) to keep token latency bounded.
neha: Quick command for ops if rollback needed: `deploy rollback --region=eu --to-version=v2.2.9 --reason="canary-sla-breach"`
ryan: If we need extra headroom for APAC later, I'll pre-authorize burst capacity with cloud team (req# CB-1721).
maria: Sounds good. Will monitor user-facing metrics and notify stakeholders if any regression.
sre-oncall: Will keep watch, alert threshold set and escalation to oncall@redwood if hit.
emma: Thanks all — I'll update the release notes with the APAC delay and the EU pin. Proceeding to keep US at 5% for next 30m, then EU canary when warmup completes. :thumbsup:
neha: copying the rollback snippet to runbook. :white_check_mark:
